title: Towards Modality-Agnostic Seizure Classification: A Unified Deep Learning Framework for Heterogeneous EEG and Intracranial EEG Signals
abstract: arXiv:2610.16596v2 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Seizure prediction and detection, essential for clinical treatment of epilepsy, remain the crucial task of this neurological disease. EEG and iEEG are widely used to analyze epilepsy due to its capability of capturing discriminative brain activities at high time resolution. However, existing works generally analyze either EEG or iEEG seizure activity separately, where EEG analysis has been well-researched, while more and more works consider iEEG for its higher specificity at the spatial level and signal quality. Currently, most of the existing seizure prediction systems are single-modal in nature, which limits its application to a variety of clinical conditions. Therefore, a common framework to analyze seizures with both EEG and iEEG signals needs to be developed. This paper presents a new framework of multimodal seizure classification integrating the heterogeneous EEG and iEEG recordings from different subjects and sources. A specific

translated_title: 迈向模态无关的癫痫发作分类：面向异构脑电图与颅内脑电信号的统一深度学习框架
translated_abstract: 癫痫发作的预测与检测对于癫痫的临床治疗至关重要，仍然是这一神经系统疾病的核心任务。脑电图（EEG）和颅内脑电图因其能够以高时间分辨率捕捉具有判别性的大脑活动而被广泛用于癫痫分析。然而，现有工作通常分别分析EEG或iEEG的癫痫发作活动，其中EEG分析已得到充分研究，而越来越多的工作则因其更高的空间层面特异性和信号质量而采用iEEG。目前，大多数现有的癫痫发作预测系统本质上都是单模态的，这限制了其在各种临床条件下的应用。因此，需要开发一个能够同时利用EEG和iEEG信号分析癫痫发作的通用框架。本文提出了一种新的多模态癫痫发作分类框架，整合了来自不同受试者和来源的异构EEG和iEEG记录。
tldr: 该论文提出了一个统一的深度学习框架，能够整合来自不同受试者和来源的异构EEG与iEEG信号进行模态无关的癫痫发作分类，突破了现有单模态系统的应用局限。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a unified deep learning framework for modality-agnostic seizure classification that integrates heterogeneous EEG and intracranial EEG (iEEG) recordings from different subjects and sources, overcoming the limitations of existing single-modal systems.
